text: Modern philanthropic strategies entrust donors with identifying which problems need to be solved and with providing the solutions, rather than trusting the solutions proposed by the nonprofits themselves, which makes the approach more centralized and less grassroots.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3981021
